name: Replacement property identification
what: The signed written identification of replacement property in a like-kind exchange.

fields.label: Taxpayer
fields.definition: The exchanging taxpayer the identification is made for; compare it with the name on the relinquished property's deed and the exchange agreement.

fields.label: Signed by
fields.definition: Who signed for the taxpayer and in what capacity.

fields.label: Sent to
fields.definition: The person the identification was sent to, such as the qualified intermediary or the seller of a replacement property.

fields.label: Date sent
fields.definition: The date the signed identification was sent.

fields.label: Delivery method and proof
fields.definition: How it was sent and the proof kept, such as an email confirmation, a courier receipt or the recipient's signed acknowledgment.

fields.label: Identification deadline
fields.definition: The last day of the identification period, from the exchange agreement.

fields.label: Properties identified
fields.definition: Each property identified, by legal description, street address or distinguishable name, with its expected price.

fields.label: Identification limit relied on
fields.definition: Which limit the list relies on: three properties of any value, more properties within the 200-percent value limit, or the 95-percent rule for acquiring nearly all of what was identified.

fields.label: Relinquished property value
fields.definition: The value of the relinquished property on the date it was transferred, used to test a list of more than three properties.

fields.label: Combined value identified
fields.definition: The combined expected value of every property on the list.

fields.label: Revocations
fields.definition: Any written revocation of an earlier identification: the date, the signer, the recipient and the property revoked.
